sources.quote: Now Google’s threat intelligence group says it had a mole inside the hackers’ inner circle.
Google’s threat intelligence group said it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.

claims.statement: Google's threat intelligence group says it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.

sources.quote: TeamPCP pulled off the worst-ever software supply-chain hacking spree and breached thousands of companies.

claims.statement: TeamPCP ran a large software supply-chain hacking campaign affecting thousands of companies.

headline: Google says it had an undercover analyst inside the TeamPCP hacking group
summary: Both reports say Google's threat intelligence group has disclosed that it had a mole inside the inner circle of TeamPCP, a software supply-chain hacking group. One adds that the group carried out the worst-ever supply-chain hacking spree and breached thousands of companies. The two texts agree on every point they both cover.
